party.programmePending: Programme not yet published (checked on {checkedAt, date, long})

home.question: What do the parties propose on the risks of AI?

description.demands: We will compare what the parties propose on advanced AI with {operator}'s demands. Every rating comes with its sources.
description.descriptive: We will review what the parties propose on advanced AI. Every rating comes with its sources.

shareDescription.demands: We will compare what the parties propose on advanced AI with {operator}'s demands, with sources.
shareDescription.descriptive: We will review what the parties propose on advanced AI, with sources.

quotes.title: Checked quotes
quotes.body: Every rating shows its sources, and every quote is checked against the original document.

history.title: Changes in the open
history.body: Every rating shows when it was last updated and keeps its history.

corrections.title: Public corrections
corrections.body: If we get something wrong, we fix it and record it in a public log.

errors.tooManyTokens: You already have as many tokens as you can keep at once. Revoke one you no longer use first.
errors.notForTokens: A tool's token can't do this.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.forbidden: You aren't allowed to do that.
errors.stale: This has changed since you opened it, or can't be done right now. Reload and try again.
errors.linked: Something this refers to has gone, or something still refers to it.
errors.limit: That limit has been reached. Try again later.
errors.notFound: That isn't there any more. Reload the page.
errors.lastCountryAdmin: This is the site's only country admin. Give someone else that role first.
errors.notMember: Only members of the site can be given a role directly. Anyone else needs an invitation.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.draftExists: There is already a draft of this text. Edit that one, or discard it first.
errors.needsDefaultLanguage: Publishing needs the text in the site's default language.
errors.mailFailed: The email couldn't be sent, so nothing was kept. Try again later.
errors.tooSoon: A link was sent to this account less than 15 minutes ago. Wait a little before sending another.
errors.notEnrolled: This member hasn't set up two-step verification yet, so a link would let whoever reads their email into the account. Ask whoever runs the platform.
errors.holdsRole: This person already holds that role here.
errors.cellChanged: Someone changed this cell since you opened it.
errors.tooLarge: That file is too large: the limit is 50 MB.
errors.fileType: That kind of file can't be stored. Use a PDF, an HTML page, plain text, or a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.hasCopy: This source already has its stored copy, which never changes. Add another source for a new document.
errors.otherType: This file is already stored here as another kind of document. Upload it as that kind.
errors.logoImage: A logo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image, at most 2 MB and 4,096 pixels a side, and really be the kind of file its name says.
errors.changeControlled: This election is live: this changes only through a change request.
errors.fetchRefused: That address can't be fetched: only public web addresses can (http or https, on the usual ports). Download the document and upload it instead.
errors.fetchFailed: The site didn't give the document: it answered with an error, too slowly or not at all. Try again later, or download it and upload it instead.
errors.fetchUnavailable: Fetching isn't available right now. Try again in a moment, or upload the file instead.
errors.noUrl: This source has no address to fetch or archive.
errors.hasArchive: This source already has its archived snapshot.
errors.themeContrast: No text reads on that colour well enough: choose a lighter or a darker one.
errors.noCopy: Store the source's copy first: its snapshot is taken with it, once its address can't change.
errors.siteIcon: A site icon is a square PNG image, 512 to 1,024 pixels a side.
errors.restrictedAsset: That image is one of the platform's restricted brand assets: only a PauseAI chapter may use it.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in with the email address your invitation was sent to.
signIn.noAccount: Accounts are by invitation only. If you need one, ask your team's coordinator.

challenge.title: Two-step verification
challenge.intro: Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows for this account.
challenge.backupIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each one works once.

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.intro: Every account needs a second step: a code from an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or 2FAS.
enrol.scanTitle: Add this account to your app
enrol.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enrol.qrLabel: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
enrol.manual: If you can't scan it, add the account by hand with this key:
enrol.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows, to check it works.
enrol.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager: they won't be shown again.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.intro: Choose the password for your account. This link works once, for an hour.
setPassword.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong one that is easy to remember.
setPassword.done: Sign in with it now. If you haven't set up two-step verification yet, you will do it next; otherwise, signing in asks for your code as before.
setPassword.missing: This page needs the link you were given. Open that link instead.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your account. If it has one, we will send it a link to choose a new password. The link works once, for an hour.
forgot.sent: If {email} has an account here with two-step verification, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It can take a few minutes, so look in your spam folder too. An account is sent one link every 15 minutes at most.
forgot.secondFactor: Choosing a new password signs the account out everywhere. Your second step stays as it is: signing in still asks for the code from your authenticator app.
forgot.lostAuthenticator: Lost your authenticator app and your backup codes, or never finished setting up two-step verification? A link can't help then, and none is sent: ask the person who runs the platform.

home.title: Your sites
home.noTenants: You don't have access to any site yet. Your team's coordinator can give you a role.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is not right.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter an email address, such as name@example.org.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then sign in again.
errors.tooManyCodes: Too many wrong codes for this sign-in. Please sign in again.
errors.expired: This sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.invalidLink: This link no longer works: it works once, for an hour. Ask for a new one.
errors.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

invitation.title: Your invitation
invitation.missing: This link has no invitation in it. Open the link from the email again.
invitation.invalid: This invitation can't be used: it may have expired, been revoked or been used already. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
invitation.offer: This invitation is for {email}, to work on {site} as {role}.
invitation.newAccount: You have no account yet: choose your name and a password. Then sign in and set up two-step verification.
invitation.name: Your name
invitation.nameHint: As your team will see it.
invitation.created: Your account is ready and the invitation accepted. Sign in to set up two-step verification.
invitation.existing: This address already has an account. Sign in with it, then open the link from the email again to accept.
invitation.otherAccount: You are signed in with another account. Sign out, then open the link again.
invitation.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
invitation.limit: Too many attempts from here. Wait a few minutes and try again.

sites.platformAdmin: As a platform admin, you see every site.

dashboard.platformAdmin: You are a platform admin: you may do here what every role may.
dashboard.notPublic: This site isn't public yet: nothing of it shows on the public site until a platform admin turns it on.
dashboard.membersIntro: Who has access to this site, and with which roles.
dashboard.settingsIntro: Review settings, how long reports are kept, and the policy texts.
dashboard.electionsIntro: Each election's details, methodology, parties and criteria.

signups.title: Signup list
signups.intro: People waiting to hear when the site is ready. Their addresses are never shown here.
signups.unconfirmed: {count, plural, one {# address waiting to be confirmed} other {# addresses waiting to be confirmed}} (deleted after 7 days)
signups.confirmed: {count, plural, one {# confirmed address} other {# confirmed addresses}}
signups.futureElections: {count, plural, one {# of them also wants} other {# of them also want}} to hear about future elections

queues.title: Waiting for you
queues.intro: Your work across the site's elections: the first of each, and how many in all.
queues.changes: Change requests waiting for a decision ({count})
queues.reports: {count, plural, =0 {No new reports} one {# new report} other {# new reports}}
queues.failedSources: Sources whose text couldn't be extracted ({count})

dashboard.previewHint: Every page as the public will see it once the site is open, with the elections in preview and the live ones, and never indexed. Its links and images work; its forms and buttons don't.

members.title: Members
members.intro: Everyone with access to this site and the roles they hold. A role that is removed stops working on the member's next request.
members.manageIntro: To give someone new access, invite them below.
members.name: Name
members.onlyCountryAdmin: The site's only country admin: give the role to someone else before removing it.
members.resetBody: {name} gets an email with a link to choose a new password, valid once, for an hour. You never see the link or the password. Their second step stays as it is, and choosing a password signs them out everywhere.
members.resetSent: A link to choose a new password was sent to {name}.
members.rolesIntro: Tick each role {name} holds on this site. A role that is removed stops working on their next request.

roleHints.country_admin: Runs the site: its members, settings and elections' status.
roleHints.editor: Writes ratings with their quotes, and adds sources.

members.loseAccess: With no role, {name} no longer has access to this site.
members.loseAccessSelf: With no role, you no longer have access to this site.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

review.title: Review
review.liveEdits: A second person must approve changes to a live election
review.liveEditsHint: When on, whoever proposes a change to a live election (its name, date, methodology, parties or criteria) can't approve it themselves. Every approved change is public either way.
review.platformOnly: Only a platform admin changes this.

colours.title: Colour
colours.label: The site's colour
colours.hint: Behind the site's name on every page and on every share image. The site writes in black or white on it, whichever reads better; the ratings' colours never change.
colours.readable: {colour}: text on it has a contrast of {ratio}:1, which reads well (WCAG AA).
colours.unreadable: {colour}: neither black nor white text reads on it well enough (best contrast {ratio}:1, at least 4.5:1 needed). Choose a lighter or a darker colour.
colours.resetDone: The site uses the platform's colour again.

retention.title: Reports
retention.label: Days a report is kept before its personal data is removed
retention.hint: A change applies to reports sent from then on: each report's date is set when it arrives.

texts.title: Policy texts
texts.intro: The texts the public site shows about the operator and its policies, written per language. A published version never changes; the next one starts as a copy of it.

logos.title: Logos
logos.intro: The images of the organization that runs the site, as the public site shows them. Each is a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 2 MB.
logos.platformImage: Now the platform's image «{name}»: one of your own replaces it.

operator_logo_on_accent.label: Logo on the site's colour
operator_logo_on_accent.hint: On the share images, on the site's colour: usually a dark or single-colour version.

operator_logo_on_canvas.label: Logo on white
operator_logo_on_canvas.hint: In the footer and on light backgrounds.

operator_logo_on_inverse.label: Logo on dark
operator_logo_on_inverse.hint: On the share images when the site's colour is dark: usually a white version.

operator_mark.label: Mark
operator_mark.hint: A square, smaller version of the logo, for where the whole logo doesn't fit.

site_icon.label: Site icon
site_icon.hint: In the browser's tab: a square PNG of 512 to 1,024 pixels. Without one, the platform's icon.

texts.copyIntro: This starts as a copy of the published version. Saving it keeps it as a draft until it is published.
texts.firstIntro: Write the first version. Saving it keeps it as a draft until it is published.
texts.bodyHint: The public site shows it formatted: a blank line separates paragraphs, a line starting with # is a heading, **this** is bold, and [text](https://…) is a link.
texts.publishBody: A published version never changes: any later change starts a new version. It needs the text in the site's default language.
texts.deleteBody: The draft's text is lost. Published versions stay.
texts.readOnly: Only country admins and platform admins write these texts.

elections.title: Elections
elections.intro: An election is prepared in private as a draft. Its structure can be changed freely until it goes live; after that, changes go through change requests.
elections.newIntro: A new election is a draft, with a second reviewer required to publish and no freeze window.
elections.name: Name

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: As the public site will show it.
form.slugHint: The election's address on the public site: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 63 characters. It can't change once the election is live.
form.territoryHint: The subdivision's code after {prefix}: one to three letters or digits, such as AN.
form.territoryPickHint: Where it is held, if not in the whole country.
form.territoryNone: A general or European election covers the whole country.
form.dateHint: Election day. It can be left empty until it is set.
form.introHint: The text that opens the election's page, above the summary table: what is compared and how to read it. In Markdown. Once the election is live, it changes through a change request.

constraints.slug: Use only lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 63 characters.
constraints.slugLocale: An address name can't look like a language code, such as es or pt-br.
constraints.slugReserved: That address name is kept for the public site's own pages.
constraints.slugTaken: Another election already uses that address name.
constraints.territoryNeeded: A regional election needs its territory.
constraints.territoryNotAllowed: A general or European election has no territory.
constraints.territoryFormat: Use one to three letters or digits after the country's code.
constraints.nameNeeded: Write the name in at least one language.

election.liveNotice: This election is live: its structure changes only through change requests, which have a public note.
election.archivedNotice: This election is archived: its structure is read-only. Corrections to published cells can still be made.
election.announced: Announce this election on the site's coming-soon page
election.announcedHint: The coming-soon page then gives its name and date, and nothing else about it. It needs the name in the site's default language, and can't change once the election is live.
election.isAnnounced: Announced on the site's coming-soon page.
election.fourEyes: A second person must review cells before they are published
election.fourEyesHint: When on, nobody who worked on a cell can publish it.
election.fourEyesOffTitle: Let one person publish their own work?
election.fourEyesOffBody: With this off, one person may write a cell and publish it themselves. Each such publication is recorded privately as self-reviewed. Turn it off only if the team can't have a second reviewer.
election.deleteIntro: A draft election can be deleted once its methodology, parties, criteria and sources are gone.
election.deleteBody: The election is deleted for good. Only a draft with nothing left in it can be deleted.
election.deleteLinked: Delete its methodology, parties, criteria and sources first.
election.previewNotice: This election is in preview: only the site's members see it, in the site's preview, as the public will. It is edited as a draft, and nothing goes to the corrections log until it is public.
election.seePreview: See it in the site's preview
election.announceNeedsName: Announcing it needs the election's name in the site's default language: add it under Details first.

statusLines.draft: Only the site's members see it.
statusLines.preview: Its members see it as the public will, in the admin's preview.
statusLines.live: The public sees it; its structure changes only through change requests.

next.draft: Next: open its preview, once everything below is done.
next.preview: Next: make it public, once everything below is done.
next.live: Next, once the results are in: archive it.

election.purgeIntro: Platform admins only. Deletes the election whatever its status, with everything in it: its methodology, parties, criteria, sources, cells, published ratings and their corrections, reports and history. A record of the deletion is kept.
election.purgeBody: Everything in it goes for good, published ratings and corrections included, and the public site stops showing it. This can’t be undone.
election.typeToPurge: Type the election's address name, {slug}, to delete it permanently

methodology.kind: Kind: {kind}. It is the site's, and the same for all its elections.

kindNames.demands: the parties' positions compared with an organisation's demands
kindNames.descriptive: a description of each party's position

methodology.none: This election has no methodology yet.
methodology.ownerHint: The organisation whose demands the parties are compared with: the site's operator or one of its endorsers.
methodology.admissible: Sources that may back a rating
methodology.admissibleHint: Quotes can only come from these kinds of source.
methodology.notMentionedHint: A “not mentioned” rating is backed by having checked documents of these kinds.
methodology.usage: Used by {quotes, plural, one {# quote} other {# quotes}} and {checked, plural, one {# checked document} other {# checked documents}}.
methodology.reviewersIntro: People outside the team, named publicly, who reviewed the methodology.
methodology.consent: This person has agreed to be named publicly as a reviewer
methodology.deleteReviewerBody: {name} is no longer named as a reviewer.
methodology.deleteBody: Its text and settings are lost. It can only be deleted once it has no reviewers.
methodology.removedQuotes: {count, plural, one {# quote cites} other {# quotes cite}} this kind: their cells can't be submitted or published until fixed.
methodology.removedChecked: {count, plural, one {# checked document is} other {# checked documents are}} of this kind: their cells can't be submitted or published until fixed.
methodology.kindsNeeded: Tick at least one kind in each list.

kindLabels.demands: The parties' positions compared with an organization's demands
kindLabels.descriptive: A description of each party's position

structure.readOnly: Only editors and country admins change this, while the election is a draft.
structure.deleteLinked: Cells or sources still refer to it: they go first.

parties.intro: The parties in this election, in the order the public table lists them.
parties.name: Name
parties.shortNameHint: Where space is short, such as on phones.
parties.slugHint: The party's address on the public site: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. It can't change once the election is live.
parties.slugTaken: Another party in this election already uses that address name.
parties.colourHint: Used to recognise the party, never to show a rating.
parties.websiteInvalid: The address must start with https:// or http://.
parties.territoriesHint: Only if it doesn't stand everywhere: the codes of its territories, such as {country}-AN, separated by commas.
parties.territoriesPickHint: Only if it doesn't stand everywhere: tick the territories it stands in.
parties.territoriesInvalid: Use territory codes, such as XX-AN, separated by commas.
parties.deleteBody: The party is deleted from this draft election. Its cells and sources must go first.

programme.title: Programme
programme.intro: Whether the party has published its electoral programme, and when we last checked. The public sees both, live elections included.
programme.neverChecked: Not checked yet: the public sees nothing about it.
programme.needsSource: “Published” needs a source of the party marked as its programme. Add one in its sources first.
programme.readOnly: This election is archived: its programme statuses no longer change.
programme.retired: This party left the election: its programme status no longer changes.

parties.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB and 4,096 pixels on a side. It shows beside the party's name on the public site and its images.
parties.websiteHint: Its website's full address, starting with https://.
parties.logoFailed: The party was saved, but its logo wasn't: {error} You can choose it again here.

problems.slugMissing: Write the name it will have in the address.
problems.slugInvalid: Use only lowercase letters without accents, digits and single hyphens, 63 characters at most.
problems.slugTaken: Another party of this election already uses that address name.
problems.colourInvalid: Write the colour as # and six digits or letters from a to f, like #1a2b3c, or pick it.
problems.websiteInvalid: The address must start with https:// or http://.
problems.territoriesInvalid: Use territory codes of the site's country, like {country}-AN, separated by commas.
problems.nameNeeded: The name needs text in some language.

parties.dataLive: The election is live: its details change through a change request, published with its note in the corrections log.

criteria.intro: The criteria the parties are assessed against, in the order the public table shows them.
criteria.title: Title
criteria.shortTitleHint: It heads the criterion's column in the public table, so it has room for a few words only. Going live needs it in the site's default language.
criteria.slugHint: The criterion's address on the public site: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. It can't change once the election is live.
criteria.slugTaken: Another criterion in this election already uses that address name.
criteria.textNeeded: Write the title and the description in at least one language.
criteria.coreHint: Optional: the platform-wide criterion this one matches, for comparisons across countries.
criteria.deleteBody: The criterion is deleted from this draft election. Its cells must go first.

status.goLiveIntro: Going live makes the election, its methodology, parties and criteria public, and every cell without a published rating shows as pending. It can't be undone.

needs.activeTenant: The site is public (a platform admin turns it on)
needs.partyNames: Every party's name and short name in {language}
needs.criteriaTexts: Every criterion's title, short title and description in {language}

warnings.noReviewers: The methodology names no external reviewers.

status.notReady: Going live is offered once nothing above is missing.
status.confirmBody: Its address name, type and territory are fixed from then on, and its structure changes only through change requests, each with a public note. This can't be undone.
status.typeSlug: Type the election's address name, {slug}, to confirm
status.freezeIntro: While the window is on, nothing public about the election changes: no publishing, no approval of change requests and no programme status. Drafting, reviewing and comments go on.
status.frozenUntilHint: Empty: frozen until the window is cleared. Times are your browser's.
status.frozenNow: Frozen since {from, date, medium} {from, time, short} UTC, until {until, date, medium} {until, time, short} UTC: nothing public about this election changes until then.
status.frozenOpenEnded: Frozen since {from, date, medium} {from, time, short} UTC, until the window is cleared: nothing public about this election changes until then.
status.frozenSoon: A freeze window starts {from, date, medium} {from, time, short} UTC.
status.archiveIntro: After the results, the election is archived: it and its structure become read-only. Corrections and withdrawals of published cells, new sources for them and report handling continue. It can't be undone.
status.archiveBody: The election and its structure become read-only for good. Corrections and withdrawals of published cells, new sources for them and report handling continue.
status.archiveFrozen: Clear the freeze window first: an archived election can't change it, and corrections would stay frozen with it.
status.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
status.slugMismatch: That isn't the election's address name. Type it exactly.
status.openPreviewIntro: The preview shows the election to the site's members as the public will see it, with its published ratings, while you keep editing it as a draft. The public sees none of it until you make it public. It doesn't go back to draft.
status.previewNotReady: The preview is offered once nothing above is missing.
status.previewConfirmBody: The site's members will see it in the site's preview. You keep editing it as a draft, except that a party or criterion with published ratings stays. It doesn't go back to draft, and it can no longer be deleted.
status.typeToArchive: Type the election's address name, {slug}, to archive it

platform.title: Platform
platform.intro: What every site shares, for platform admins.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.intro: The organizations that run or endorse a site. What you write here is public: it appears on the sites each one serves, the legal notice included.
organizations.caption: Organizations and the sites each serves
organizations.name: Name
organizations.newIntro: An organization can serve several sites. Linking it to a site is done separately.

form.displayNameHint: As the public sees it, in the languages of the sites it serves. At least one.
form.legalNameHint: As registered. The legal notice gives it.
form.legalOnlyHint: Only for an organization that runs a site: it appears in its legal notice. For one that only endorses a site, leave it empty.
form.registryEntryHint: The register it is entered in, and its number there.
form.contactEmailHint: Shown on its sites as the address to write to.
form.privacyEmailHint: The address for questions about personal data.
form.linkHint: A full address starting with https://.
form.pauseaiHint: Its sites may use PauseAI's restricted brand assets only while it is one, so it can't stop being one while they do.
form.logoHint: Kept among the platform's images: a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 2 MB.
form.logoFailed: The organization is saved, but its logo wasn't: {error}

constraints.email: Enter an email address, such as name@example.org.
constraints.link: Enter a full address starting with https://.
constraints.displayName: Enter its name in at least one language.
constraints.pauseai: A site this organization serves uses PauseAI's restricted brand assets, so it has to stay a PauseAI chapter.

platformSites.title: Sites
platformSites.intro: Every site on the platform, on or off. A site's addresses are added by whoever runs the platform, and listed on the site's page.
platformSites.caption: Sites and their addresses
platformSites.name: Name
platformSites.newIntro: A new site starts off: nobody outside the admin sees it until you turn it on. Its operator is the organization that runs it and answers for it in the legal notice.

form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, such as demo. It names the site in the admin's and the platform's addresses, and doesn't change. Not “new”, which the admin keeps.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: As the public sees it, in the site's languages. At least one; text in a language the site doesn't have is left out.
form.countryCodeHint: Its country. A demonstration site takes one of the codes no country has.
form.methodologyKindHint: The same for all the site's elections, and fixed once one has a methodology.
form.operatorHint: The organization that runs the site. Create it first under Organizations if it isn't listed.
form.reportRetentionDays: Days a report is kept before its personal data is removed

active.title: Public site
active.on: On: its addresses serve it, with the coming-soon page until it is opened below.
active.off: Off: nobody outside the admin sees it.
active.turnOnBody: Its addresses start serving it within a minute: its coming-soon page, or every page once it is open.
active.turnOffBody: Within a minute, every address of the site answers that there is nothing there, until it is turned on again.

open.title: Open to the public
open.on: Open: its addresses show every page, with its public elections, their parties, criteria and published cells.
open.off: Coming soon: its addresses show only the coming-soon page and the always-on pages (legal notice, privacy policy, about the operator, the signup list's pages).
open.openTitle: Open this site to the public?
open.openBody: Within a minute, its addresses show every page of its live and archived elections, with their parties, criteria and published cells. Make sure what they show is ready.
open.closeTitle: Put this site back to coming soon?
open.closeBody: Within a minute, its addresses show only the coming-soon page and the always-on pages again. Links people shared to its election pages stop working until it opens again.
open.closed: The site is coming soon again.

indexing.title: Search engines
indexing.off: Kept out of search engines: every page asks not to be indexed, and the site has no sitemap.
indexing.hide: Keep it out of search engines
indexing.hideTitle: Keep this site out of search engines?
indexing.hideBody: From now on its pages tell search engines not to index them, and it has no sitemap. Pages already indexed drop out as search engines visit them again. For a demo's fictional content.
indexing.showTitle: Let search engines index this site?
indexing.showBody: Its pages may then appear in search results. Do this only for a real site, never a demo.
indexing.hidden: The site is kept out of search engines.
indexing.shown: Search engines may index the site.

analytics.title: Visit counts
analytics.intro: Visits are counted with Plausible, without cookies, on the site's main address only.
analytics.scriptHint: Name the Plausible site {host}, this site's main address, and enter the file name from its installation snippet, such as pa-AbC123.js. Empty, nothing is counted.
analytics.noAddress: This site has no main address yet, so nothing would be counted: visits are counted only there.
analytics.saved: Saved. It applies within a minute.
analytics.invalid: Enter the file name only, such as pa-AbC123.js.

hostname.title: Addresses
hostname.intro: Adding an address, or making another one the main one, is done by whoever runs the platform: they check the address is the site's, then set it up with its certificate.

constraints.slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 63 characters.
constraints.slugTaken: Another site already uses that address name.
constraints.countryCode: Enter two letters, such as ES.
constraints.retention: Enter a number of days from 1 to 36500.
constraints.name: Enter its name in at least one of its languages.
constraints.operator: A site that is on needs an operator.
constraints.slugReserved: The admin keeps that address name for itself. Choose another.

detailsForm.mainLanguage: {language} is its main language: the public addresses are in its words, so it doesn't change.
detailsForm.restrictedOperator: This site uses PauseAI's restricted brand assets: a PauseAI chapter has to run it.
detailsForm.operatorChange: {name} becomes the site's operator: its legal notice, and who is responsible for its reports and signups, change with it.
detailsForm.languagesRemoved: The site stops being in {languages}: its pages in them go, and links to them stop working.

cells.title: Cells
cells.intro: Each party's rating on each criterion. Open a cell to draft it, review it or see its history.
cells.caption: Every party × criterion cell, with its state
cells.version: {version, plural, =0 {Not edited yet} one {Edited once} other {Edited # times}}
cells.notStarted: Nobody has started this cell. Its public page says it is pending.
cells.locked: In review: the draft can't change until it is recalled or sent back.
cells.ratingWithdrawal: No rating: this draft withdraws the published one.
cells.summaryHint: What the public reads under the rating. The site's main language is needed to submit.
cells.changeKindHint: A correction when what was published was wrong; an update when the facts changed, such as a new programme; a withdrawal takes the rating down.
cells.publicNoteHint: Why it changed, in the corrections log. The site's main language is needed to submit.
cells.reportHint: A right-of-reply or error report this change answers. It stays private: the report shows the revisions that answer it.
cells.stale: Someone changed this cell since you opened it. Reload it to see their change, then save yours again.
cells.quotesIntro: Each quote must appear word for word in its source's stored text, which is checked again on submit and publish; a quote from a source without text (a scan, a video, a post) is attested instead, by someone else, against a screenshot or clip.
cells.noCitable: This party has no source that can be cited yet: one needs a stored copy and its text extracted, and not to be replaced.
cells.quoteHint: 15 to 1,000 characters, copied from the source.
cells.sectionLabelHint: A hint for reviewers only: the public sees the pages the quote matches.

live.tooShortNormalised: Too short once spaces and typography are evened out: {length} characters, at least 15.
live.longestStart: The source has the start of it, up to: “{text}” ({location}). The difference begins right after.
live.longestEnd: The source has the end of it, from: “{text}” ({location}). The difference ends right before.
live.failed: Couldn't check it now. It is checked when you add it.

pick.title: Text of the source
pick.hint: Select a passage here, then use it: it fills the quote and its page. The quote is still checked when you add it.
pick.failed: The source's text couldn't be loaded. Type or paste the quote instead.
pick.none: This source has no extracted text to pick from.
pick.nothing: Select a passage of the source's text first.
pick.tooLong: The selection has {length} characters; a quote has at most 1,000.
pick.done: Filled from {location}. Check the quote, then add it.

cells.checkedIntro: “Not mentioned” needs at least one of the party's own documents, checked and stored.
cells.noCheckable: This party has no stored document of a kind the methodology lists for “not mentioned”.

checklist.title: What submitting needs
checklist.intro: Checked again when it is submitted for review.
checklist.noRating: No rating, since it withdraws the published one
checklist.checkedDocument: A checked document: one of the party's own, stored, of a kind listed for “not mentioned”
checklist.quotesMatched: Every quote matches its source or is attested, from a kind the methodology admits
checklist.checkedKinds: Every checked document is of a kind listed for “not mentioned”

cells.publishBody: The public sees it within a minute: the rating, the summary and every quote with its source.
cells.publishSelfBody: Four-eyes is off for this election, so you can publish your own work; it is recorded as self-reviewed. The public sees it within a minute.
cells.cannotPublishOwn: You worked on this draft, and this election needs a second person to publish it.
cells.rejectNoteHint: Its editors read this on the cell and in their queue.
cells.deleteBody: Its draft, quotes and checked documents are deleted for good. Only a cell never published can be deleted.
cells.recheckBody: The party's programme was marked published after this cell was rated “not mentioned”. Check the programme, then clear the flag.
cells.someone: Someone who isn't a member of this site
cells.publishNotYet: Cells are published once the election is in preview or live: until then they can be reviewed and sent back.
cells.selfReviewed: Published by one of its own authors, while the election didn't require a second reviewer.

attestation.noFile: No screenshot or clip yet: someone attaches one, and someone else attests the quote against it.
attestation.clip: Said from {start} to {end} into the clip.
attestation.noClip: Where in the clip it is said: not given yet.
attestation.attestHint: Attesting says the words above are what the screenshot or clip shows or says. Download it and check them first.
attestation.needsFile: It can be attested once a screenshot or clip is attached.
attestation.authorCannot: You wrote this quote, so someone else attests it.
attestation.contributorCannot: You worked on this cell's draft, or uploaded a file it cites, so someone else attests its quotes.
attestation.fileLabel: Screenshot or clip for the quote
attestation.replaceLabel: Another screenshot or clip for the quote
attestation.fileHint: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image, or an MP4 or WebM video, or an MP3, M4A, Ogg or WebM audio clip, up to 50 MB.
attestation.contributor: Storing it changes the quote, which undoes its attestation, and counts as working on this cell: you won't attest its quotes or publish it.
attestation.uploaded: The screenshot or clip is attached.
attestation.clipLegend: Where in the clip the quote is said
attestation.lapses: Attested by {name}, who has since worked on this draft, so the attestation lapses before publishing: withdraw it, and someone else attests.
attestation.fileType: That kind of file can't be attached. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image, or an MP4 or WebM video, or an MP3, M4A, Ogg or WebM audio clip.
attestation.otherType: These bytes are already stored here as another kind of file. Attach them as that kind.
attestation.clipTimeHint: As minutes and seconds, such as 1:23 or 1:23.5 (or hours too, 1:02:03).
attestation.clipTimeInvalid: Write a time as minutes and seconds, such as 1:23.

cells.publicNoteHintPreview: Why it changed. While the election is in preview it is never published: the corrections log starts when the election goes live. The site's main language is needed to submit.
cells.replacedOnlyTitle: "Not mentioned", checked only against replaced documents
cells.replacedOnlyBody: Every document this rating was checked against has been marked replaced: check the new version before submitting it, or correct it if it is already published.

bar.title: The draft

states.published: Published: a change starts a new draft

bar.leave: Your changes to this cell aren't saved. Leave the page and lose them?
bar.checklistUnsaved: Some changes aren't saved yet: this list counts the saved draft. Sending it for review saves them first.

cells.clipEndAfterStart: The end comes after the start.

startChange.notice: This cell is published as its history below shows. A change starts a draft, which goes through review again before the public sees it.

sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: The documents cells cite: each party's programme and anything else we quote. A source can be cited once its copy is stored and its text extracted.
sources.caption: The election's sources, with their state
sources.citations: {count, plural, =0 {Not cited} one {Cited once} other {Cited # times}}

fields.title: Title, as published
fields.titleHint: In its original language, as the party published it.
fields.urlHint: Where it was published, if anywhere: starting with https:// or http://.
fields.languageHint: The language it is written in.
fields.noParty: None: it isn't any one party's
fields.programme: This is the party's electoral programme
fields.programmeHint: Only a party's source can be its programme. The party's programme status can be set to published once one is marked.
fields.urlInvalid: The address must start with https:// or http://.
fields.languageInvalid: Use a two-letter language code, such as en, with a region if needed, such as pt-br.

copy.title: Stored copy
copy.none: No copy is stored yet. Until one is, the fields above can change; afterwards the source never changes.
copy.fileHint: A PDF, a web page saved as HTML, plain text, or an image (PNG, JPEG or WebP), up to 50 MB.
copy.contributor: Whoever stores the copy counts as having worked on every cell that cites it, so while a second reviewer is required, they can't publish those cells.
copy.final: Once stored, the source and its copy never change: a wrong one is replaced by a new source.
copy.uploaded: Copy stored. Its text is being extracted.
copy.unavailable: Copies can't be stored here yet: the file store isn't set up.
copy.fetch: Fetch a copy from its address
copy.fetchHint: Fetches the document at the source's address, as a browser would, in a few seconds at most. Whoever fetches it counts as having stored it.
copy.fetched: Copy fetched and stored. Its text is being extracted.

extraction.title: Extracted text
extraction.pending: Its text is being extracted. Reload the page in a moment.
extraction.unavailable: Text extraction isn't set up here yet: the copy waits until it is.
extraction.failed: The text couldn't be extracted, so this source can't be cited. Replace it with a new source whose copy has readable text.
extraction.notApplicable: This copy has no text to extract, such as an image or a scan. Quotes from it need attesting.
extraction.units: {count, plural, one {# page or section} other {# pages or sections}}
extraction.intro: What quotes are matched against, word for word, never shown to the public.

sources.deleteBody: The source is deleted for good. Only a source with no stored copy can be deleted: once a copy is stored, its text is kept for good.
sources.deleteCited: Cells cite it, or its copy is stored: it can't be deleted.
sources.readOnly: Only editors and country admins change sources.
sources.replacedOn: Marked replaced on {date, date, long}. It takes no new quotes or checks, and is listed last; the ones it has stay.
sources.replaceIntro: When a newer version of this document is added as a source of its own, mark this one replaced: it then takes no new quotes or checks, and is listed last. The quotes and checks it has stay as they are.
sources.replaceBody: It will take no new quotes or checks, and be listed last; the ones it has stay. This can't be undone.

archive.title: Archived snapshot
archive.requested: A snapshot has been asked for. It appears here once the archive has taken it: reload the page in a few minutes.
archive.none: No archived snapshot yet. Citing and publishing don't need one.
archive.asked: Asked the archive for a snapshot.
archive.withCopy: When its copy is stored, a snapshot of its address is asked for from a public web archive: anyone can look the address up there.

copyChoice.fetch: Fetch it now from its address
copyChoice.needsUrl: Fetching it needs the source's address.
copyChoice.failed: The source is added, but its copy wasn't stored: {error}

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: People join by invitation only. The link works once, for {days} days, and only for the invited address.
invitations.caption: Invitations and their state
invitations.emailHint: The address the link goes to. Only an account with this address can accept it.
invitations.deleteBody: Its record, with the email, goes for good. Only an accepted, revoked or expired invitation can be deleted.
invitations.noMail: Invitations need the platform's email, which isn't set up on this deployment.

changes.title: Change requests
changes.intro: Once an election is live, its structure changes only through a change request: someone proposes the change with a public note, and a country admin approves it, someone other than the proposer if the site requires a second approver. The change and its note then appear in the public corrections log.
changes.notLive: Change requests are for live elections: a draft's structure is edited directly on its screens.
changes.proposeElection: Propose a change to the election
changes.proposeMethodology: Propose a change to the methodology

labels.name: Name
labels.admissible_source_kinds: Kinds of source that can back a rating
labels.not_mentioned_source_kinds: Kinds of source that can back "not mentioned"
labels.title: Title

changes.notMember: someone who isn't a member of this site
changes.approveBody: It is applied now, and it and its public note appear in the corrections log. This can't be undone, only changed again by another request.
changes.rejectBody: Nothing changes, and the request stays in this list as rejected.
changes.withdrawBody: It is deleted, as if never proposed. Only pending proposals can be withdrawn.
changes.ownNeedsOther: This site needs someone other than the proposer to approve it.

form.title: Propose a change
form.noteHint: Published with the change in the corrections log: say what changed and why, at least in the site's main language.
form.applyHint: Applies it at once, as its approver: this site doesn't require a second approver.
form.codesHint: Territory codes inside the site's country, separated by commas.
form.codesPickHint: Tick none if it stands everywhere in the country.
form.needsDefaultLanguage: The public note and every text need the site's main language.
form.reportHint: A right-of-reply report this change answers: the report will list it.
form.nothingChanged: Nothing has changed yet: change at least one detail before proposing it.
form.editTitle: Propose a change to its details
form.editIntro: Change whatever details need it: everything is proposed together, with one public note, and approved or rejected as one change.
form.defaultLanguage: Write it in the site's main language, {language}, too.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: What the public sends through each election's form: mistakes in ratings and parties' replies. Triage each one, then accept, reject or mark it as spam. A correction or a change request that answers it links it, and it shows here.
reports.platformAdmin: Platform admins don't read reports: they hold personal data, which is the site's members' to handle.

detail.title: Report
detail.name: Name
detail.removedOn: Its personal data is removed on {date}, as the site's retention says.

triage.title: Triage
triage.noteHint: Only the site's members see it; it goes with the personal data when that is removed.
triage.decided: A decided report stays decided; its note can still change.

anonymize.title: Remove this report's personal data?
anonymize.body: Its sender's name, email and organisation, the message and the internal note go for good. What it is about, its status and what links to it stay.

links.title: What answers it
links.none: Nothing links to it yet. When you propose a change to a live election, choose this report under “Prompted by a report”.

reports.notMember: someone who isn't a member of this site

meanings.triaged: Seen, not decided yet: someone will look into it.
meanings.accepted: It points at a real mistake: the cell or the election's structure gets corrected.
meanings.rejected: Not a mistake: what is published stands.

reports.proposeChange: Propose a change to the election because of it
reports.proposeChangeHint: Each change's form lets you say it answers this report.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Who changed what in this site, and when, newest first: every write to its data, with what changed by column. Personal data is never in it.
audit.platformIntro: Changes that belong to no site: organizations, brand assets, platform admins and the like.
audit.someone: someone who isn't a member of this site ({id}…)

image.drop: Drop a PNG, JPEG or WebP image here, or choose one:

problems.type: That file isn't a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. SVG images aren't accepted.
problems.size: That image is over 2 MB: save it smaller.
problems.dimensions: That image is over 4,096 pixels on a side: save it smaller.
problems.unreadable: That image can't be read: it may be damaged.

problems.localized: Write it in at least one language.
problems.confirm: Tick this box to go on.

problems.url: Enter a full address starting with https:// or http://.
problems.https: Enter a full address starting with https://.
problems.slug: Use only lowercase letters without accents, digits and single hyphens, 63 characters at most.
problems.whole: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
problems.invalid: This value can't be taken: check it.

slug.label: Address name
slug.hint: Lowercase letters without accents, digits and single hyphens, 63 characters at most. It follows the name until you change it.
slug.fixed: It can't change once the election is live.
slug.hintSaved: Lowercase letters without accents, digits and single hyphens, 63 characters at most.

problems.type: That kind of file can't be stored: use a PDF, an HTML page, plain text, or a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

territories.findHint: By its name or its code.
territories.noMatch: No territory matches what you typed.

rechecks.title: {count, plural, one {One "not mentioned" rating to check again} other {# "not mentioned" ratings to check again}}
rechecks.body: They were checked only against documents since marked replaced, such as an earlier programme: they say nothing about the new version. Check it, and correct the rating if it now does mention it.

tokens.title: Tokens for tools
tokens.intro: A token lets a tool on your computer, such as an AI assistant, work in the admin as you, to save you typing: it reads your sites and drafts an election's parties and their logos, and proposes changes to a live election.
tokens.limits: It never publishes, approves, rejects or changes who has access, whatever your roles: a person does those here. Everything it writes is recorded in the history as written with a token.
tokens.care: Keep a token as you would a password: anyone who has it can act as you within those limits until it expires or you revoke it. Revoke one you no longer use, or one you think someone else has seen.
tokens.name: What it's for
tokens.nameHint: The tool and the computer, so you recognise it in this list.
tokens.created: Token created. Copy it now: it won't be shown again.

revoke.label: Revoke the token for {name}
revoke.title: Revoke this token?
revoke.body: A tool using it stops working at once. This can't be undone.

signupConfirm.subject: Confirm you want to hear when {site} is ready

invitation.subject: You're invited to work on {site} as {role}

passwordReset.subject: Choose a new password for {platform}
passwordReset.body:
Hello,

Someone, probably you, asked for a new password for the account with this address on {platform}.

To choose one, open this link within an hour. It works once:
{link}

Choosing a new password signs the account out everywhere. Signing in still asks for the code from your authenticator app.

If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

{platform}
passwordReset.bodyByManager:
Hello,

{manager}, who manages the members of {site}, sent this address a link to choose a new password for your account on {platform}. They don't see the link or your password.

To choose one, open this link within an hour. It works once:
{link}

Choosing a new password signs the account out everywhere. Signing in still asks for the code from your authenticator app.

If you don't need a new password, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

{platform}

passwordChanged.subject: Your password for {platform} was changed
passwordChanged.bodyNoFactor:
Hello,

The password of the account with this address on {platform} was just changed, and every session of the account was signed out. The account has no authenticator app yet: whoever signs in next with the new password sets one up.

If it wasn't you, tell whoever coordinates your site at once, by some way other than this email.

{platform}

reportPage.representative: I speak on behalf of the party
